description: The business owner approves one exact revision of a drafted email campaign, named by campaign_id and the fingerprint returned by draft_email_campaign or get_email_campaign. A changed draft has a new fingerprint and needs a new approval. Sends nothing; launch_email_campaign queues it. Business owner only.

business_id.description: The business that sends the email.

fingerprint.description: Fingerprint of the exact revision the owner reviewed.

name: approve_email_campaign
title: Approve Email Campaign
